note: Read 2026-10-13: TechDataSheets2026.pdf (cdn.shopify.com, robots ok) and cuttingedgebullets.com blog/collection/product pages (robots ok). All lines solid copper lead-free -> monolithic_copper; MTAC is a non-expanding target bullet -> match. Tip: LAZER 'expanding hollow point' (tip material not stated, so hollow_point), MTH 'hollow point counterpart'; MTAC nose not stated. Base not stated for any line (only FB Raptor, not in records, is flat base). 'MAX'/'GEN2'/'SINGLE FEED' suffixes not explained, so MAXIMUS-line text was not applied to MAX records.
